summary: The central risk is exclusion disguised as smart convenience: a service can appear innovative while shifting cost and failure onto people without devices, literacy, language access, or confidence. Geometry and implementation uncertainty are equally explicit.

dimensions.label: 数据隐私
dimensions.note: Voice, accessibility, maintenance, and service inquiries may expose sensitive information if public terminals over-collect.
dimensions.mitigation: Use environmental or aggregate data by default, keep sensitive cases off public interfaces, and publish retention rules.

dimensions.label: 实施复杂度
dimensions.note: The proposal crosses public space, transport, accessibility, operations, enterprise testing, and municipal coordination.
dimensions.mitigation: Start with reversible interface prototypes and only deepen after survey, code, ownership, and operator confirmation.
dimensions.human_review: Planning, transport, accessibility, municipal, heritage, safety, and operations specialists must review each phase.

dimensions.label: 公众接受度
dimensions.note: Robotics and AI services can create anxiety, nuisance, or an impression of surveillance even when technically compliant.
dimensions.mitigation: Use visible test boundaries, plain-language notices, opt-out routes, fixed hours, and staffed conversation before expansion.
dimensions.human_review: Resident, disability, worker, visitor, and small-business representatives should review pilots before renewal.

dimensions.label: 运维成本
dimensions.note: Human fallback, maintenance, multilingual materials, and device repair require recurring budgets rather than one-off capital spending.
dimensions.mitigation: Treat staffing and maintenance as core infrastructure, publish service levels, and retire prototypes that cannot be reliably operated.
dimensions.human_review: A prospective operator and finance team must confirm lifecycle cost and staffing.

dimensions.label: 政策不确定性
dimensions.note: Official polygons, controls, road redlines, heritage, utilities, and approval paths are not in the public package.
dimensions.mitigation: Keep all alignments and intensities conceptual, preserve unknown metrics, and recalculate the full package when official data arrives.
dimensions.human_review: Competent authorities and licensed professionals must confirm statutory and engineering conditions.

dimensions.label: 空间争议
dimensions.note: New service tables, test yards, slow routes, and events may compete with movement, quiet, access, or existing uses.
dimensions.mitigation: Use time-sharing, reversible furniture, clear bypass routes, and transparent conflict logs.

dimensions.label: 技术成熟度
dimensions.note: Voice, embodied AI, edge models, and adaptive equipment can fail or discriminate in real public settings.
dimensions.mitigation: Expose failure modes, constrain test conditions, retain manual controls, and require immediate human intervention.

dimensions.label: 公平与包容性
dimensions.note: A screen-first or QR-only public realm would exclude people by device, ability, age, language, connectivity, and trust.
dimensions.mitigation: Enforce dual-channel equivalence, co-design with excluded users, audit service completion by channel, and fund human fallback.
dimensions.human_review: Disability, aging, child-friendly, multilingual, and digital-rights reviewers must have decision power in pilots.
